acceptance_summary: A segmented mathematical dial shows both inactive sockets and a selected set of luminous violet, blue, and gold nodes. Several spatially separated attack lanes fire rightward into one hostile faceted region; each impact routes a distinct cyan return arc into a large lower life-light reservoir that crystallizes into Margin. The outgoing multi-hit fan and lower healing-return circuit remain recognizable at 100x76 and in grayscale. No character, weapon, text, UI, red/crimson line, blood, liquid, strand, or mouth-emitted element is present.
